title: the-postman-rides
intention: The bus delivers: an envelope posted to a device is handed to that device's shim and a receipt is written, so that posting mail and mail arriving stop being the same observation.
why: Measured 2026-08-11: BaseShim.deliver — the method that hands an envelope to a device and wakes it — had stood with ZERO CALLERS since the day it was written. post wrote durable envelopes, read returned them whole, and nothing on earth drained an inbox. From the sender's side that is indistinguishable from a working bus: the post succeeds, the row lands, the read shows it sitting there. Three envelopes were in transit when this was found, the oldest addressed to a device that has never once looked. This ticket is the second half of the ground-loop discovery work: the loop discovered its devices and pulsed them, and the mail still went nowhere.
traces_to: Law 7 (a message that cannot be delivered must not fail silently — the trouble lane's founding example in Akien's own 2026-07-25 words); Law 6 (the owner of the traffic delivers it: the postman is the BUS's own shim, never the heartbeat, because handing an envelope to its addressee is ROUTING and the ground_loop does not route); Law 1 (the roster the heartbeat already publishes is reused rather than a second registry minted, so nothing new can go stale).

proves_green.prove_gate: SATISFIED, and sealed by the tester rather than narrated — see receipts.validations. The seal ran under netns isolation and reports seal=sealed, so the green is not an unconfirmable seal laundered into a pass.
proves_green.feeds_back_on_failure: exercised for real: the discovery proof KILLED this build's own bench gate before it shipped (see receipts.what_the_proof_killed)
proves_green.extra_gates: durability — committed as f9774d2 and pushed
proves_green.not_satisfied: The chart chain, the BUILDME/PROVEME/PROVED crossings, and the verdict artifact. Named here rather than papered over: this node cannot honestly claim PROVED, because PROVED is a crossing a gate performs and no gate performed it.

falsifier.proves_red: RED on any of: an envelope handed to a device without a receipt being written afterward; a receipt written for an envelope a raising receiver never took; a shim with no device silently returning None from deliver instead of refusing; the drain issuing more than one query per beat regardless of roster size; or a single undeliverable envelope stopping the heartbeat.
falsifier.horizon: closed at the build, 2026-08-11 — the standing questions moved to the successor node
